channel.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI
channel.description: A non-AI view of GitHub Trending — a daily digest of open-source tools, libraries, languages, and projects trending right now.

item.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI — October 2, 2026
item.description:
Today's 52 trending open-source repositories, with AI-focused projects filtered out. Highlights:

  1. public-apis/public-apis (485,414 ⭐) — A collective list of free APIs
  2. freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp (456,626 ⭐) — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
  3. nilbuild/developer-roadmap (368,694 ⭐) — Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
  4. vinta/awesome-python (324,614 ⭐) — The definitive list that answers "I want to do X in Python, which tool should I use?"
  5. awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted (323,324 ⭐) — A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
  6. practical-tutorials/project-based-learning (285,591 ⭐) — Curated list of project-based tutorials
  7. react/react (250,859 ⭐) — The library for web and native user interfaces.
  8. torvalds/linux (250,807 ⭐) — Linux kernel source tree
  9. TheAlgorithms/Python (225,204 ⭐) — All Algorithms implemented in Python
  10. yt-dlp/yt-dlp (194,893 ⭐) — A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader
